hint.en: Rain or no rain: take both sides.

hint.zh: 分情况时，两边要证出同一句话。
hint.en: When taking cases, both sides must prove the same sentence.

t.zh: 下雨就坐公交，不下雨就骑车。不知道下不下雨，可总有一样。
t.en: If it rains I take the bus; if not, I cycle. I do not know whether it will rain, but it will be one or the other.
